name: Comic Sticker Saga
oneLine: Locked game-set shots cut every 1.45 s, anime-hair block heroes with a new line-art face each close-up, and a comic sticker layer: name cards, bubbles, time tags, question card.
bestFor: Character-driven 'in this town' stories with 3-5 named people, reveals and reactions (rivals, a strange new arrival, a curse, a secret), Part 1 / Part 2 and vote episodes.
brightness: mean luma 102 (89-113 per reel); true blacks (p5 0-15), whites 222-232 with bloom; per-shot luma SD about 60
saturation: 0.42 HSV mean (0.34-0.46); natural colour, accents live in the graphics
avgShot: 1.45 s average, 1.3 s median (about 41 cuts a minute); story shots 0.4-3.1 s; end cards 4-8 s
camera: Locked inside shots (under 1 px a frame of drift), eye level about 85%; framing wide 19 / medium 35 / medium close-up 24 / close-up 18 / insert 4%; 1-2 key moves per film (slow pull-out about 2x in 1.4 s, 30° orbit in 1.6 s, crane-down 500 px/s, snap zoom +17% in 5 frames); no whips, no shake on impacts
characters: Blocky R6 bodies on the classic head with flat line-art face decals; oversized anime hair (1.3-1.8x head width) as identity; 3-5 featured people; the lead's face changes in almost every close-up (8-12 expressions per film); see characters.json
textures: Smooth plastic bodies, printed clothes, realistic dense game sets (brick, plaster, wood grain, glossy floors), bloom on whites; flat vector stickers with ink outlines; no toon outlines on 3D
animation: Stock rigid-limb game motion; poses change between shots; one 6-8 frame reaction then idle; impacts by falling bodies in a static frame; captions pop for 1 frame at 108%; stickers pop over 5 frames
captions: Always on; 1-3 words (mean 1.9), median 0.5 s, 1.88-1.90 a second (3 reels); Poppins ExtraBold about 110 px caps, white with a 6-7 px ink outline and a shadow; baseline at y 67%, dropping to 79% on face close-ups; keyword colour on 35-50% of caption time (yellow > red > lilac); spoken dialogue yellow in quotes
sound: Fast narrator from 0.16 s (about 3.6 words a second, pauses 0.1-0.45 s); the account uses a continuous bed 20-25 dB under the voice (no bass for the first 6-15 s, swells at the end) and sparse low hits (0-4 per film; none on the snap zoom or flash). House default stays effects-only: thumps on key cuts, pops on stickers.
length: 86-100 s total: about 80-90 s story + a 4-8 s question card (+ sponsor in the Instagram edition)
overrides: House saturation 0.55-0.65 -> 0.40-0.48 natural colour with true blacks and bloom (needs Jake's yes)
Frame 0 title picture -> no title on frame 0; a moving mid-scene picture, with the premise on the closing question card
Moth Wings finishing shakes and the shake-in opening -> none; only one snap zoom per film
The 11-23 steady-then-glide structure -> cuts all the way through (consistent with the 11-25 evening rule 1)
No music bed -> unchanged by default; the account's bed is optional only with Jake's yes
